summary: A Colorado woman in her early 30s fell about 300 feet down a couloir at about 11,000 feet just west of Ptarmigan Lake and south of Turner Peak while descending off Cottonwood Pass Road; after a 23-member Chaffee County Search and Rescue North technical snow evacuation over six pitches, she reached hospital by 1 p.m. with only minor lacerations, bumps, and bruises.
location: Couloir west of Ptarmigan Lake, south of Turner Peak, off Cottonwood Pass Road
responding_agency: Chaffee County Search and Rescue North
notes: Run 995 Mountain Mail chunk: Mountain Mail article reporting a Sunday rescue; article record dated 2017-05-08 pins the Sunday to 2017-05-07; party had parked north of the Denny Creek Trailhead.
